messages:
maria_cs: FYI — customer 'Orbis Inc' reported ~120 users lost product roles right after an Okta org-merge. They say SCIM sync ran and removed roles. Can we triage?
jon_eng: Ack. Do we have the SCIM events/logs from the time of the merge? thread id from their support ticket?
alex_am: Ticket #7521. Customer says two Okta orgs were merged (org-A + org-B) into a single directory; some users from org-B ended up with different externalIds and then lost role mappings. They saw a SCIM PATCH that removed members from a group right after the SSO merge.
maria_cs: Pasting the minimal snippet they forwarded (redacted):
```
2026-03-12T15:22:03Z INFO scim: PATCH /Groups/00ab12cd - payload: { "members": [] }
2026-03-12T15:22:04Z INFO scim: response 200 OK (event_id=ev-9c7f)
```
jon_eng: Hmm empty members patch. That looks like Okta sent an authoritative replace. Do we know their provisioning connector settings? specifically attribute used for group-to-role mapping (email vs externalId)?
tanya_sre: Checked the audit: Okta mapping was set to map groups -> roles by user.email, but the org-merge process canonicalized primaryEmail for some accounts and moved old accounts into a merged record. For ~120 users the externalId changed and our SCIM reconcile treated them as distinct and removed old member refs.
alex_am: Customer: "We never intended removal — roles should have been preserved on merged profiles."
jon_eng: Repro attempt: steps I used locally: 1) create two Okta users with same email but different externalId; 2) create group with members referencing externalId A; 3) simulate Okta merge by pushing a PATCH replacing members with an array referencing externalId B only. Result: our model treats absent externalId A as removal and drops mapping -> downstream role deleted.
maria_cs: So the root cause appears to be that our SCIM group patch is processed as authoritative replace and we don't attempt to reconcile identity merges by email.
tanya_sre: Workarounds we can offer now: a) Ask Okta admin to push merged profile that contains both externalIds in a secondary attribute temporarily, or b) turn off immediate deprovisioning in the customer's SCIM connector (set deprovisioning to manual) while we run a reconciliation job.
jon_eng: Short-term fix: Add a reconciliation step that, when a user removal is observed, attempts an email-based lookup before fully deleting role assignment. I'll open an internal PR to gate deletions on a matched-email check for the next tenant sync window.
maria_cs: Customer update: please give exact repro steps & ETA for a soft fix. They are anxious — product access degraded for some teams.
jon_eng: ETA: PR today, patch in staging by EOD, limited rollback flag (feature flag: scim.defer_deprovision_on_email_match) to enable per-tenant. If enabled it will: on group-member-removal event, check for same primaryEmail in active users within the tenant; if match found, treat as merge and preserve role binding and create a reconciliation task.
alex_am: I'll relay that. Any immediate manual recovery steps we can run for the affected users?
tanya_sre: Yes — run our ad-hoc reconciliation script: `python tools/scim_reconcile.py --tenant orbis --since 2026-03-12T14:00Z --match-by email` This will list mismatches and create a CSV to reapply roles. We can run it during a maintenance window.
maria_cs: Customer asked for exact logs they should collect next time: ask them to include Okta system log entries for the merge (eventType: user.migrate or import), SCIM outbound payloads, and our SCIM event_id.
jon_eng: Also noted: for long-term we should update docs to recommend using `externalId` as a stable immutable identifier for group mappings, or provide an option to prefer `email`-tolerant merges.
alex_am: Customer accepted the mitigation: they're disabling auto-deprovision for now and asked us to run the reconcile job tomorrow morning UTC. I'll set the handoff. :thumbsup:
jon_eng: I'll open the PR and link it here when ready.
jon_eng: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/scim/pulls/671 — feature flag included, unit tests added.
maria_cs: Thanks team. Follow-up: add a KB article that explains org-merge scenarios and recommended SCIM config.
okta-bot: Notification: Okta outbound connector replayed 120 PATCH events for tenant orbis at 2026-03-12T15:21:52Z - 2026-03-12T15:23:10Z (job id: replay-88)
jon_eng: Noted. We'll schedule reconcile tomorrow and keep customer updated.
